en_title: Former BioWare Executive Producer Mark Darrah Shares Original Vision for a More 'Immersive' Dragon Age 4
cn_title: BioWare前执行制作人Mark Darrah分享《龙腾世纪4》最初构想，曾希望打造更「沉浸」的体验
opus_summary: BioWare资深成员Mark Darrah公开了一份2016年的内部企划，展示《Dragon Age 4》原方案Joplin的构想，包括可破坏环境、动态天气和劫案玩法。他表示，即使开发顺利，其中许多功能也会被舍弃。Joplin后来取消，项目最终改制为单人游戏《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》。

paragraphs.en: BioWare veteran Mark Darrah has revealed an internal pitch for Dragon Age 4 that was never shared with fans.
paragraphs.cn: BioWare资深成员Mark Darrah披露了一份从未向粉丝公开的《龙腾世纪4》内部提案。

paragraphs.en: This pitch was shared in the form of a book which Darrah says was distributed within BioWare and to higher ups at EA. The idea behind the book was to “remain relevant” with the publisher, and to try and secure early funding and new hires for the project.
paragraphs.cn: 这份提案以一本书的形式传阅，Darrah称，它被分发给了BioWare内部人员和EA高层。制作这本书的目的是在发行商那里「保持存在感」，并尝试为项目争取早期资金和新员工。

paragraphs.en: “There's always a fear, and I think a legitimate fear, within a big publishing organization that you will get cancelled or in, the in case of EA, you will simply be allowed to be to remain on a starvation diet to the point where you cannot continue,” Darrah said in a new video published to his YouTube channel .
paragraphs.cn: Darrah在其YouTube频道发布的一段新视频中说：「在大型发行组织内部，人们总会担心项目被取消，我认为这种担心是合理的；或者说，在EA的情况下，他们会让你一直处于资金匮乏的状态，直到你无法继续下去。」

paragraphs.en: “This is where ultimately this book comes into being,” he continued. “This was made in mid-2016 to be something that I could give to the team, but also something I could give senior people within the EA organization to say, ‘Look, we're doing a Dragon Age. Don't forget that Dragon Age: Inquisition was a super great game that sold super well, so you want another one, right?’"
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「这就是这本书最终诞生的缘由。它制作于2016年年中，既是为了让我能把它交给团队，也是为了让我能把它交给EA组织内的高层，对他们说：『看，我们正在做一款《龙腾世纪》游戏。别忘了《龙腾世纪：审判》是一款非常棒的游戏，销量也非常好，所以你们想再要一款，对吧？』」

paragraphs.en: The book focusses on what was then referred to as Joplin, the original plan for a fourth Dragon Age game. This was later cancelled in favour of a live service Dragon Age 4, which in turn, was partially scrapped and retooled in the single-player Dragon Age: The Veilguard.
paragraphs.cn: 这本书聚焦于当时名为Joplin的项目，也就是《龙腾世纪》第四款游戏的最初计划。该计划后来被取消，转而开发一款在线服务型《龙腾世纪4》；后者又被部分废弃并重新制作，成为单人游戏《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》。

paragraphs.en: As for Joplin, this book gives us an idea as to what BioWare was cooking behind the scenes. For starters, we can see that there was a chapter on the game having a "reactive world." However, in The Veilguard, reactions to decisions made in previous games were almost entirely scrapped .
paragraphs.cn: 至于Joplin，这本书让我们了解到BioWare当时在幕后酝酿着什么。首先，我们可以看到书中有一章讲述游戏将拥有一个「会作出反应的世界」。然而，在《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》中，对此前游戏中所作决定的反应几乎被全部舍弃。

paragraphs.en: Darrah also shared that BioWare envisioned destructable environements, dynamic weather conditions, and social interactions that went beyond the standard BioWare conversations. There’s even a reference to the player taking part in heists, something we haven’t seen in the series before.
paragraphs.cn: Darrah还透露，BioWare设想了可破坏的环境、动态天气状况，以及超出BioWare标准对话模式的社交互动。书中甚至提到了玩家参与劫案，这是我们此前在该系列中没有见过的内容。

paragraphs.en: With that said, Darrah admitted that many of these features would have been scrapped even if development went well. In fact, BioWare was in the process of phasing out heists in 2017. But it does show us the vision BioWare was chasing, with a desire to make the series much more immersive than previous entries.
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，Darrah承认，即使开发进展顺利，这些功能中也有许多会被舍弃。事实上，BioWare在2017年时正逐步取消劫案内容。但这确实向我们展示了BioWare追求的愿景：希望让该系列比以往作品更具沉浸感。

paragraphs.en: While Darrah failed to reveal the full content of the books, he did share the opening he wrote back in 2016:
paragraphs.cn: 虽然Darrah没有透露书中的全部内容，但他分享了自己在2016年写下的开篇：

paragraphs.en: “Dragon Age: Inquisition has transformed what the franchise is and how it is perceived by the public. As we move forward, we have a great opportunity to continue the breakout we have started.
paragraphs.cn: 「《龙腾世纪：审判》改变了这个系列的面貌，也改变了公众对它的看法。随着我们继续前进，我们有一个绝佳的机会，延续我们已经取得的突破。

paragraphs.en: “We stand upon the foundation laid by Dragon Age: Inquisition. A foundation that lets us see further. To see things that didn't work and fix them, to see things that did work and improve them.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们站在《龙腾世纪：审判》奠定的基础之上。这一基础让我们看得更远，让我们看到不成功的地方并加以修正，看到成功的地方并加以改进。

paragraphs.en: “The Dragon Age team will create a more immersive interactive world with people in it who act and react like real people. We have a lot of work to do, but never has a Dragon Age game started in a stronger place. This document represents our current thinking on the next steps of the franchise.”
paragraphs.cn: 「《龙腾世纪》团队将创造一个更具沉浸感的互动世界，其中的人物会像真人一样行动和作出反应。我们还有许多工作要做，但从未有哪款《龙腾世纪》游戏在起步时拥有如此有利的条件。这份文件代表了我们目前对该系列下一步发展的思考。」

paragraphs.en: Needless to say, the developers did not get the development cycle they were hoping for. Instead, Joplin was scrapped, and Dragon Age stagnated to make way for Mass Effect: Andromeda and Anthem. The Dragon Age series was put on ice after The Veilguard failed to reach EA’s sales targets .
paragraphs.cn: 不用说，开发者们并没有获得他们期望的开发周期。相反，Joplin被废弃，《龙腾世纪》的开发陷入停滞，为《质量效应：仙女座》和《圣歌》让路。在《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》未能达到EA的销售目标后，《龙腾世纪》系列被搁置。

paragraphs.en: Now, BioWare has been shut down by EA. Many fans are fighting to save BioWare’s work, particularly the now-cancelled Mass Effect Universe, but we certainly shouldn’t expect any developments in the Dragon Age series anytime soon.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，BioWare已被EA关闭。许多粉丝正努力挽救BioWare的作品，尤其是如今已被取消的《Mass Effect Universe》，但我们肯定不该期待《龙腾世纪》系列在短期内有什么进展。
